submission.natural_language_explanation: This negative pole fires retrospectively on social-media/chat-domain tokens (chat, tweet/tweets, Facebook, Twitter): a lone 'chat' already drives strength ~2.3 and stacks ('chat chat chat', 'Facebook Twitter tweets') drive it to 7-10, far above the scan max of 1.57, so the scan corpus, which contains no social tokens, caught only weak baseline flickers. Its output direction strongly suppresses exactly those trigger tokens (Jacobian and logit lenses agree at overlap 1.0, kurtosis 5.1, suppressed z ~ -9 to -11), i.e. a suppression neuron that detects chat-domain tokens, with a 1-3-token lingering tail, and damps them.
